Q5217.reason: The confirmation was expressly conditional on the loading charge, so under UCC 2-207(1) it is a counteroffer rather than an acceptance, and Rainmaking never accepted it.

Q8260.reason: Water is made when oxygen accepts electrons at the end of the electron transport chain, so it stops at once, while glycolysis keeps producing some ATP and pyruvate.

Q5585.reason: A lay witness may estimate vehicle speed once a foundation of observation and experience is shown, so the objection is overruled.
